description: This source file contains a test fixture class 'TestApiApplication' for functional testing of the Public API endpoints in the eShopOnWeb project. It extends 'WebApplicationFactory' to configure an in-memory database setup for testing purposes within a testing environment.

classes.name: TestApiApplication
classes.description: A custom WebApplicationFactory for setting up the test environment for the Public API, specifically replacing database contexts with in-memory databases.
